content.text: Digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan face significant barriers when trying to sell courses online due to restrictions imposed by platforms like Teachable and Stripe. With Stripe operating in only 46 out of 195 countries, many creators find themselves unable to access essential tools for monetizing their content. This post explores how you can sell courses without relying on these conventional platforms, leveraging sovereign commerce infrastructure instead.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a foundational approach that empowers digital creators to build their online stores without the limitations posed by traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-working-today-2|payment]] platforms. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Pages, NOWPayments, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-19|How Supabase]], you can create a fully functional e-commerce solution that allows for the sale of digital products, including courses. This infrastructure matters because it ensures that you retain complete ownership of your data and revenue, providing a sustainable alternative to platforms like Stripe and PayPal that often exclude entire regions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-20|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] of sovereign commerce infrastructure operates on a combination of free and paid tools designed to work seamlessly together. For instance, Cloudflare Pages can host your e-commerce site while Supabase serves as the backend database for storing orders. NOWPayments facilitates automatic crypto payment processing, ensuring you receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. This combination eliminates the need for traditional banking systems and gives you the ability to sell your courses directly to consumers, bypassing the restrictions of conventional platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or heavily restricted. If you are in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, this solution provides a pathway to monetize your skills and products without the fear of account suspensions that can freeze your funds for up to 180 days. By using sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can maintain control over your business and avoid reliance on platforms that do not prioritize accessibility for creators in your region.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you complete control over your digital sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of sovereign commerce infrastructure include a range of tools that work together to create a robust e-commerce experience. For instance, Cloudflare Workers enable backend logic to process transactions efficiently, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 can be used for file delivery of your digital products. The integration of NOWPayments ensures that you can process payments in a decentralized manner, further enhancing your sovereignty. Each component is designed to be easily deployable, offering you a complete stack to launch your online store.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign commerce stack, start by selecting the Edge Commerce Stack for $197, which includes everything you need to get up and running in 48 hours. Begin by setting up your Cloudflare Pages account to host your site, followed by configuring Supabase for order management. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and test your setup thoroughly. Finally, load your digital products and promote your store. For resources, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore options.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, consider using the Edge Commerce Stack, which provides a complete solution for selling digital products. This stack utilizes cloud-based infrastructure and supports crypto payments, allowing you to bypass restrictions imposed by conventional platforms, giving you full control over your sales and data.
Eliminate the dependency on platforms that restrict your access to essential tools.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

You can sell digital products by using sovereign commerce infrastructure, which allows you to create an online store without relying on Stripe. Utilize tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments to set up your e-commerce site, enabling you to process payments directly.

The Edge Commerce Stack is an excellent alternative to Gumroad for creators in restricted countries. It provides all the necessary infrastructure to sell digital products, including automated crypto payment processing and data ownership, empowering you to operate independently.
Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?

Using PayPal in these countries can be complicated due to restrictions and potential account suspensions. Instead, consider using a sovereign commerce stack that provides reliable payment solutions without the limitations of traditional platforms.
Are there fees associated with using crypto payments?

Yes, while using NOWPayments for crypto transactions incurs a low fee of 0.5%, it is significantly lower than traditional payment processors. Additionally, there are no subscription fees, making it a cost-effective solution for digital creators.
